verbas.name: Home Assistant Lists & Tasks
verbas.description: Adds, updates, removes, and reads back items on Home Assistant to-do lists and the shopping list.

verbas.name: On Demand Briefing
verbas.description: Spoken briefings on demand with configurable sections: time, weather, news, UniFi Protect camera activity, and BLE presence. Includes Morning and Welcome Home briefings, configurable briefing definitions, and optional background audio with ducked TTS announcements.

verbas.name: Roku TV
verbas.description: Control Roku TVs by voice over the local network (ECP): power on/off, play/pause, volume, mute, HDMI input, home/back, and YouTube launching. TVs are configured as profiles (name, IP, linked satellite) so each room's voice satellite only controls its own TV.

cores.name: Jarvis Screen
cores.description: JARVIS SCREEN: a full-screen Iron-Man style display controlled by Hydra. It builds generative cards and layouts (JARVIS chat, web, YouTube, camera, HA entities) around a TTS-pulsing arc reactor, with per-screen unlock (Face ID, tap, PIN), in-browser voice input (tap-to-talk, 'hey jarvis' wake word, follow-ups), and visual screens/cards/layout managers including a drag-to-place layout editor. Full setup and configuration: docs/jarvis_screen.md.

cores.name: Personal Music Core
cores.description: Per-person music for Tater: link each Person to their own Emby, Jellyfin, Subsonic, or Plex account or network-share folder (or two sources at once), browse and play their library with voice control, and build AI-named recommendations from each Person's listening history across clock-synchronized satellites, native Sonos groups, stereo pairs, and media players — with selectable Endless Playback modes (AI radio, offline Infinite Mix, or looping a chosen playlist), Smart Shuffle that mixes several queued sources on the fly, per-Person sleep timers, and optional Follow-Me presence that moves a Person's music to the room they're in, tracked through Home Assistant person entities or Tater's native BLE presence.
